newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: OVERHAUL OF MOZAMBIQUE'S CAHORA BASSA ON TRACK.
newsitem.headline: OVERHAUL OF MOZAMBIQUE'S CAHORA BASSA ON TRACK.

text.p: Work to rehabilitate Mozambique's giant Cahora Bassa hydro-electric scheme on the Zambezi river is proceeding satisfactorily, despite some construction delays, the permanent joint committee (PJC) said on Thursday.
PJC delegations represeting Portugal, South Africa and Mozambique met here to review progress on the project and expressed "overall satisfaction" with steady progress.
To date 59 percent of the foundations have been laid while 40 percent of new towers have been assembled, despite some delays due to unusually high rainfall and criminal related incidents.
The rehabilitated project is due to be commissioned on March 31, 1997. It will also supply power to South Africa and Zimbabwe.
